title: Deflection
text:
Deflection is type of mitigation. It grants a chance to take less damage from a hit by a percentage. Like Evasion, chance to deflect is based on the defender's Deflection Rating against the attacker's Accuracy Rating. Most sources of Deflection Rating scale with the user's Evasion Rating, acting as a supplementary mitigation tool for evasion-based builds.


== Mechanics ==
The formula to calculate deflection chance is as follows: 

  
    
      
        Uncapped Chance to Deflect
      
      =
      
        (
        
          1
          −
          
            
              
                Attacker's Accuracy
              
              
                (
                
                  Attacker's Accuracy
                
                +
                
                  Defender's Deflection Rating 
                
                ∗
                0.12
                )
              
            
          
        
        )
      
      ∗
      150
      %
    
    \color [rgb]{0.6392156862745098,0.5529411764705883,0.42745098039215684}{\text{Uncapped Chance to Deflect}}=\left(1-{{\text{Attacker's Accuracy}} \over ({\text{Attacker's Accuracy}}+{\text{Defender's Deflection Rating }}*0.12)}\right)*150\%
  

Deflection chance is capped at 95%.
Unlike Evasion, Deflection will work against boss attacks with a red flash.


== Related mechanics ==


=== Tailwind ===

Tailwind grants 1% of Damage from Deflected Hits prevented per stack. At 10 stacks, it will cause Deflection to reduce incoming damage by 50%.
